newsitem.title: JAPAN: All Tokyo corn futures end sharply lower.
newsitem.headline: All Tokyo corn futures end sharply lower.

text.p: All Tokyo corn futures ended sharply lower on Monday, as long-liquidation by local investors hit the market from the start, traders said.
Prices were 150 to 380 yen lower, with the benchmark January 1998 contract down 150 yen at 14,960 yen per tonne. The day's volume was 83,901 lots.

Individual investors, who were discouraged by the Chicago market's price losses overnight, started selling from the opening, traders said. Some investors accelerated selling orders at nearby months by the afternoon, they said.
The spot March corn contract on the CBOT Project A trading system was being traded at $2.71 per bushel at 0810 GMT, down from $2.73-1/4 at Friday's close.
The spot January for CBOT soybean futures on the overnight trading system was at $7.39-3/4 at 0810 GMT, down from $7.46 at Friday's close.
